note: Rewritten from Light 1930 (the Amitermes of Mexico), pp. 222—223; original in English; in the soldier table the minimum postmentum width is printed as 0.42—0.54, which contradicts the maximum postmentum width of 0.30, a typesetting or OCR problem in the original book; transcribed as printed and flagged. The original "gula" is rendered postmentum.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates not described. Soldier of the wheeleri species group: tooth placed very low, shelf-like, projecting very little, its proximal notch angular; mandibles inflected inward from the level of the tooth, only slightly convex, the apex curved inward very little; mandibular base relatively small; mandibles tapering from the tooth towards the apex, the apical third very slender; postmentum constriction index about 0.75. Worker very small, pale; head width about 0.8 mm; antennae short, nymph-like; clypeus length only about half its width.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body small, generally white throughout; head pale yellow; antennae yellow, darker apically, slightly smoky yellow; mandibles red, with a very short yellow portion at the base. Head long, broadly oval, sides very slightly convex, narrowing gradually and slowly from the widest point (behind the middle); posterior margin weakly convex; posterior corners rounded; head index about 0.78; head constriction index about 0.88; head high, highest in the anterior third of the head, descending gently to the rounded posterior end, frons flat and steeply inclined. Mandibles slightly shorter than the head, evenly and weakly convex throughout, the apex only a little more curved than half the mandible; mandibles tapering from the maximum width at the tooth to the very slender apex; head-mandible index about 0.96; tooth shelf-like, not projecting, separated from the body of the mandible by a deep proximal notch; antennae 14-segmented; postmentum strongly and evenly constricted, narrowest near the middle, postmentum constriction index about 0.75. Measurements (mm; 6 soldiers unless stated otherwise): head length 1.15—1.20 (mean 1.17); maximum head width 0.85—0.93 (mean 0.89); minimum head width 0.76—0.81 (mean 0.79); mandible length 1.07—1.10 (mean 1.08); postmentum length 0.77 (n = 1); maximum postmentum width 0.30 (n = 1); minimum postmentum width 0.42—0.54 (n = 1, as printed); pronotum width 0.49—0.51 (mean 0.50, n = 5); head index 0.73—0.79 (mean 0.76); head constriction index 0.87—0.91 (mean 0.89); head-mandible index 0.90—0.94 (mean 0.92); postmentum constriction index 0.75 (n = 1); mandible length used to calculate mandible curvature index II 1.05; minimum mandible curvature 0.09; mandible curvature index II 0.086.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Very small; pale, nymph-like in form; head pale yellow; antennae short, nymph-like; clypeus short, twice as wide as long, sides convex, passing smoothly into the anterior margin. Measurements (mm; 5 workers, minimum—maximum—mean): head length 0.69—0.77—0.72; head width 0.80—0.85—0.82; pronotum width 0.51—0.57—0.55.
